body:
## Pull request overview This PR establishes a comprehensive documentation infrastructure by creating a public roadmap document, initializing a VitePress documentation site with protocol specifications, and configuring automated GitHub Pages deployment for the Object UI project. **Changes:** - Created user-facing public roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`) outlining quarterly 2026 feature releases with practical examples and user-benefit focus - Initialized VitePress documentation site with homepage, guides, protocol specifications, and API references - Set up automated GitHub Pages deployment workflow with pnpm caching and build optimization ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 23 out of 25 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | docs/ROADMAP.md | 295-line English roadmap with Q1-Q4 2026 release timeline, feature examples, FAQ, and user-focused benefit statements | | docs/.vitepress/config.mts | VitePress configuration with navigation, sidebar structure, search, and GitHub Pages base path | | .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml | GitHub Actions workflow for automated documentation deployment with Node 20 and pnpm 8 | | docs/protocol/*.md | Eight protocol specification files (object, view, page, form, menu, app, report, overview) defining metadata schemas | | docs/guide/*.md | Three guide files (introduction, quick-start, installation) for getting started documentation | | docs/api/*.md | Four API reference files (core, react, components, designer) documenting package APIs | | docs/index.md | VitePress homepage with hero section, features grid, and quick examples | | docs/package.json | Workspace package configuration with VitePress 1.0.0 and dev/build/preview scripts | | pnpm-workspace.yaml | Added docs directory to workspace packages | | package.json | Added workspace entry and npm scripts for docs:dev, docs:build, docs:preview |
